posts.text: What I’d expect from Zerodha’s US Stock Investing — I agree with this overall. For me, the biggest differentiators would be transparent FX rates and proper Indian tax reporting, since those are areas where investing in US stocks can get complicated quickly. I’d also add that reliable customer support and clear regulatory and investor protection would matter just as much as low fees. If Zerodha can keep the platform as simple as its existing ecosystem while offering easy access to US stocks, I think it could be a very strong option for Indian investors.
